scope: Proposal-level DAGitty reuse selection, without executable adapter admission
plan: Verify the six previously saved source files, commit, complete repository tree and acquisition receipts against the selected Git blobs.
Acquire pinned direct dependency/build/wrapper originals and inspect their version, license, dependency and interface declarations; do not execute downloaded code.
Review adjustment, query completeness, graph validation, endpoint conversion and error meanings; restrict the preferred first profile to supplied observed DAGs and a total-effect adjustment query.
Construct independent exact finite-probability references for confounding, collider conditioning and mediation, labelled project-authored and distinct from native DAGitty calls.
Compare integrate, adopt, port, reference and reject routes; state owners, cost categories, source limits and exact revisiting conditions.
Record a pass only for an evidence-complete scoped proposal decision; withhold integration permission and leave runtime, transitive rights and scientific graph truth unqualified.

findings: A reuse decision may select a source-bounded reference/deferred route without a full installed environment; it cannot authorize an adapter without one.
Missing exposure/outcome can produce false in the inspected API; validate query completeness before treating a boolean as a scientific result.
A supplied graph is an assumption. An adjustment check does not discover the bank graph, estimate an effect or produce an uncertainty interval.
MAG/PAG syntactic checks and ambiguity-removing conversions require separate scrutiny; they are excluded from the preferred initial profile.
The root GPL text and each third-party notice must remain explicit. A process boundary alone does not remove applicable distribution obligations.
All requests are bounded public HTTPS GETs at the existing selected 2024 commit. No local data, credentials, package installation or external messages are involved.
